research_question: Can strict-prior schedule congestion and rest-state features be constructed reproducibly for the frozen R39C eligible population using only match identity, competition, team names and kickoff time, with no score/result access?

population_binding.r39c_eligibility: T-24h/T-6h/T-1h at least five identical complete bookmakers

schedule_identity.team_key: exact trimmed team name within exact trimmed league name
schedule_identity.reason: fail-safe against same-name clubs in unrelated competitions; cross-competition congestion is intentionally not inferred without a stable global team id
schedule_identity.fixture_order: match_datetime ascending, then source_file and match_id only for deterministic reporting
schedule_identity.same_datetime_rule: all fixtures at identical match_datetime are featurized from histories strictly before that timestamp, then histories are updated as one batch
schedule_identity.eligible_row_feature_source: all score-free fixture metadata rows in the same source file, including rows that fail R39C odds eligibility, provided their kickoff time is strictly earlier

report: eligible rows joined to score-free metadata
rows with both teams having at least 1/3/5 strict-prior matches
team-key collision diagnostics by league/name only
